outputNames.description:
The {@link MlPipeline#outNames pipeline outputs} that are processed by this handler.
If `null` and if there are multiple outputs to the pipeline, an error is thrown.

title:
An output handler is responsible to process the output of a {@link MlPipeline} in the context of a deployed
{@link MlModel}.
Typically, a handler converts the output and store it in a persistent location (database, file system) or forward
it to an external system (e.g. Kafka Queue).

This type is abstract and subtypes must implement the {@link process} and {@link validate} methods.
name: MlModel.OutputHandler
